ios.desc:
Struggling with erectile dysfunction, low libido, or control? Sequoia helps 79% of men feel better in just 21 days - naturally, with a science-based 21-day plan. Start for free. No awkward clinics, no meds. 

Take control of your sexual health with Sequoia - the all-in-one app to improve erections, stamina, libido, and overall intimate wellness. Whether you're facing erectile dysfunction (ED), premature ejaculation (PE), or simply want more energy in bed, Sequoia is here to help.

Built by doctors. Powered by science. Used by over 50,000 men.

Trusted Worldwide
• Partner of the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) in reproductive health
• Member of the World Association for Sexual Health (WAS)
• Partner of the University of Rome Tor Vergata
• Partner of the Invitro medical laboratory
• Partner of the Meta Clinic

Why Sequoia Works

SCIENCE-BASED HEALTH TEST
Understand your body and performance better with the IIEF - the gold-standard test in male sexual health. Get instant, personalized insights.

21-DAY PERSONALIZED IMPROVEMENT PLAN
Follow a structured, medically-backed routine to improve erections, boost sexual stamina, increase testosterone, and enhance control — no pills, no side effects.

KEGEL WORKOUTS FOR MEN
Strengthen your pelvic floor to improve erection quality, orgasm intensity, and endurance. Fully guided and proven by research.

EDUCATION & DAILY ARTICLES
Learn from doctors and sexual health experts. Topics include libido, testosterone, ejaculation, performance anxiety, relationships, and LGBTQ+ well-being.

TRACKING & INSIGHTS
Log symptoms, energy, erections, mood, and over 80 other factors. Spot trends and track your growth week by week.

DAILY CALENDAR & STREAKS
Visualize progress. Build healthy routines with reminders and a motivational calendar designed to keep you going.

AGE-SPECIFIC CHECK-UPS
Stay ahead of common issues with health screening guidelines tailored to your age - including prostate, hormone levels, and more.

PRIVATE ONLINE CONSULTATIONS
Have questions or concerns? Chat discreetly with certified doctors - no appointments, no waiting rooms.

MONTHLY REPORTS
See clear, visual reports of how your sexual health and habits are improving over time.

SMART REMINDERS
Never skip a session. Sequoia keeps you consistent with subtle nudges designed to build lasting habits.

Start Free - No Credit Card Required
Get your personalized plan instantly. Explore workouts, articles, and tools — and see results before you commit to anything.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Sequoia – App to Improve Male Sexual Health Without Pills

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I’m Aliaksei Saskevich, CTO & Software Engineer at Sequoia Health. My team and I have built an iOS app to help men improve their sexual health through lifestyle changes and guided exercises — no medications involved.

We noticed that many men struggle to talk about sexual health and often seek help only when things get critical. Our goal is to offer a science-backed, stigma-free tool that helps earlier and more effectively.

What makes Sequoia different:

- Exercises are personalized based on the IIEF test (International Index of Erectile Function).

- Content is written by certified sexologists and psychologists on our team.

- We offer optional online consultations with real specialists.

- We’re building a structured knowledge base focused on practical, non-pharmaceutical solutions.

Achievements so far:

- Partnered with a local lab to offer discounts to users.

- Members of the World Association of Sexologists.

- Official partners of UNFPA.

- Ranked #2 and #5 Product of the Day on Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/sequoia-men-s-sexual-wellness/launches.

Results:

- We ran a user survey inside the app — 79% of respondents reported improvements in their sexual health. Full report: https://sequoia.health/research/research-report-user-survey-on-sequoia-male-sexual-health-app-june-2023

- The study was accepted and presented at a medical conference.

Current features:

- 21-day exercise plan with progressive difficulty
